main.description: Favourite, or unfavourite, a gallery in a group's pool. The record is the viewer's own, written into the pool rather than their public repo: in the public repo it would name a private gallery to the whole network.

gallery.description: The gallery being favourited, by the uri it would have in its author's repo.

rkey.description: The favourite record, when there is one.

errors.name: NotAuthorized
errors.description: The viewer is not a member of this pool.
